userStories.title: Multi-dialect Drizzle integration
userStories.description: As a developer using db0 with Drizzle, I want to use any supported dialect (sqlite, postgresql, mysql) so that I can use db0's connection management with Drizzle ORM
acceptanceCriteria: Type inference works correctly per dialect
drizzle(db, { schema }) returns correctly typed Drizzle instance

userStories.title: Eager initialization option
userStories.description: As a developer, I want optional eager initialization so that getInstance() can be sync when the connector supports it
acceptanceCriteria: New option: { eager: true } in connector config
When eager + sync connector (better-sqlite3): getInstance() is sync
When eager + async connector: connection established at creation, getInstance() still sync after init

userStories.title: Consistent connector API
userStories.description: As a developer, I want all connectors to have consistent behavior so that switching dialects requires minimal code changes
acceptanceCriteria: getInstance() typing is consistent (Promise-wrapped unless eager+sync)

userStories.title: Real database testing with Docker
userStories.description: As a contributor, I want integration tests with real databases so that we catch dialect-specific issues
acceptanceCriteria: CI runs tests against real databases
Tests cover: basic CRUD, transactions, prepared statements, edge cases per dialect

userStories.title: Raw driver access for ORM composition
userStories.description: As a developer using other ORMs (Kysely, Prisma, etc.), I want clean access to the raw driver instance so that I can compose db0 with any ORM
acceptanceCriteria: getInstance() returns properly typed native driver
No db0 lock-in for ORM layer
